issues.description: The Stata source requires Crypto sample data_COMBINED.xlsx and CRSP returns_CUSIP & Date.xlsx, while the frozen package inventory does not list either file. The combined workbook holds manual filing and prepared vendor outputs; its exact schema, data provenance, and output-to-column mapping are not supplied.

The datasheet names a Plots for Paper code file among the package code; no such source appears in the frozen inventory. Its role and whether it is necessary for the target outputs are not established.

The Compustat universe and main-file stages require sic, but COMP.FUNDQ lacks it. COMP.CO_INDUSTRY provides historical sich and datadate/gvkey; the source-compatible field/date join and universe selection are not specified.

The source requires CURR_AUD_FKEY and CURR_AUD_NAME. The candidate audit product has AUDITOR_FKEY/AUDITOR_NAME instead, but their record-level meaning and date relationship to the current-auditor fields are not established.

The source consumes prepared crsp_returns.dta and crsp_mkt returns.dta, but the supplied program does not establish their producers or all joins. The raw daily CRSP.DSI market product is locally verified; the missing prepared filename still needs field-preserving date staging. For the security-return composite, CRSP name history supplies TICKER, while the PERMNO/effective-date mapping, population and required history remain unresolved.

The Python source passes error_bad_lines to pandas.read_csv, which was removed in pandas 2.0 and is incompatible with the installed pandas 3.0.6 API. The official replacement is on_bad_lines; no author program was run.

evidence.description: The search filters and matches text in the SEC TXT value field.
evidence.file: Identify Crypto Mentions in XBRL.py
evidence.quote:
def findMentions(df):
    hits = df[df['value'].notna()]
    hits = hits[(hits['value'].astype(str).str.contains(cryptorx))|(hits['value'].astype(str).str.contains(cryptorxTics))]
    hits['matches'] = hits['value'].apply(lambda x: "|".join(r[0] for r in re.findall(cryptorx,x) + re.findall(cryptorxTics,x)))
    hits['matchCount'] = hits['matches'].str.count(r'\|')+1
    return hits

review_notes: Full pipeline is the only supported scope. The package includes a Python keyword-search program and a Stata preparation/analysis program; no complete analysis-only prepared dataset and entry point is supplied.

The SEC/filing/manual hand-collection workflow, Compustat, Audit Analytics, I/B/E/S, CRSP, non-CRSP stock prices and crypto series all feed the missing author-prepared combined workbook. The appendix reports 2013Q4–2022Q4 full sample and 2013Q4–2018Q2 pre-guidance period.

Producer/consumer accounting: sample firms_CIK & FS dates.dta is generated from the packaged sample CIK/date workbook and consumed in Compustat/Audit Analytics matching; compustat_fundq_NFIRMS.dta is generated at the Compustat universe stage and consumed by the combined workbook; CRYPTO_LIQUIDITY.dta is generated from Crypto prices_volume.xlsx and consumed by the combined workbook; Crypto sample data.dta is generated after those joins and consumed by the descriptive, discretion and market-test blocks.

The Stata source also writes Compustat merged, Audit Analytics, I/B/E/S, CRSP and non-CRSP return staging outputs and comments that some are copied into the main Excel handoff. The CRSP market handoff crsp_mkt returns.dta is consumed by the non-CRSP branch although its producer is not established in the supplied source/static dependency checklist; it is covered as a required CRSP market input and unresolved preparation issue, not as an invented frozen dependency ID.

DET_EPSUS is the selected I/B/E/S raw candidate: the full consumed-field comparison and one-row readable probe support the verified local raw route. Native CUSIP capitalization is ordinary staging; sample-date history/selection remains in A_IBES_COVERAGE as future validation.

CRSP.DSENAMES supplies native PERMNO/TICKER and name effective-date fields, so TICKER is not treated as absent from CRSP. CRSP.DSI DATE/vwretd is a verified local raw market route; DATE-to-caldt naming, format/path and sample-date checks are preparation. The security-return composite’s producer, name join and population remain unresolved.
